title: eLearning System entity definition
description: Validates one entity definition file under model/entities/. Each file describes a single table-like entity: its columns, types, keys, and constraints, in a form intended to be consumed later by a component that generates SQL DDL (and possibly other artifacts) for a specific target dialect.

entity.description: Logical entity name, PascalCase singular (e.g. Campus).

table.description: Physical table name, snake_case singular (e.g. campus).

comment.description: Human-readable comment describing what this entity represents.

type.description: Abstract, dialect-independent type. A future DDL-generation component maps each of these to a concrete type per target database.

length.description: Optional max length, meaningful for type=string.

primaryKey.description: Whether this column is (part of) the primary key. For composite keys, the order of primary-key columns in the columns array is the key's column order.

unique.description: Whether this column has a standalone uniqueness constraint (in addition to, or instead of, being part of the primary key). Mutually exclusive with 'uniqueWith' on the same column — use this for a single-column constraint, 'uniqueWith' for a composite one.

uniqueWith.description: Names of other columns on this same entity that combine with this column to form a composite uniqueness constraint. E.g. ["campus_id"] on course_number generates UNIQUE (campus_id, course_number). Column order in the generated constraint is these names in the order listed, followed by this column. Mutually exclusive with 'unique' on the same column.

identity.description: Whether this column is an auto-generated identity/sequence column (SQL Server IDENTITY). An identity column cannot be nullable.

foreignKey.description: Marks this column as a foreign key referencing another entity's column.

entity.description: Referenced entity name, matching another file's "entity" value.

column.description: Referenced column name within that entity.
